Question: Since I am 23 years old ;so as per the norms issued by the govt.I may not sit in a exam of cds.because max. age limit is 19.5 yrs. so is it possible for me that i may form duplicate documents to attempt the relevant exam (this should be keep in discussion that i am going to hide my real age only) {Allah may give you reward for this. Answer ID: 13831 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1001/942=B/1430) As telling lie is sin, writing and making someone write lie is also a sinful act. Thus, getting false certificates is also sinful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
